system.description: Whenever you reduce an opponent to 0 Hit Points with an Unarmed attack, you can make a Jump check as a Free Action, moving a distance as determined by the results of your Jump check. You can use the Surge Force Power as normal to enhance this Jump check, increasing the distance you move.
